about: Game config cases written from docs/port/spec-rd27-launcher.md §2.7.6 (RL9, L5). 'engine' cases edit Engine.ini (host defaults to 127.0.0.1, port to 61099, graphics to -1; input null is a missing file), 'user_settings' cases repair GameUserSettings.ini (safe_window defaults to false), 'game' cases remove Game.ini's Phoenix sections (expected null: nothing removed). Every expected text is the file's exact output, CR LF line ends.

engine.name: an empty file gets only the XMPP section
a missing file reads as empty
the launcher's sections are dropped, the rest kept in order, leading blanks dropped
headers match by prefix in any case; a longer section name is another section
a forced preset writes SystemSettings first
engine.expected:
[SystemSettings]
sg.ViewDistanceQuality=3
sg.AntiAliasingQuality=3
sg.ShadowQuality=3
sg.PostProcessQuality=3
sg.TextureQuality=3
sg.EffectsQuality=3
sg.FoliageQuality=3
sg.ShadingQuality=3
sg.ResolutionQuality=100
r.ScreenPercentage=100

[OnlineSubsystemMcp.XMPP]
ServerAddr="ws://127.0.0.1"
ServerPort=61099
bUseSSL=false

[Core.System]
Paths=../../../Engine
